definitions.exact: Decision, complete proposal multiset (titles ignored), clarification codes and unsupported codes must all match. Invalid or missing output fails the case.
definitions.fields: Conditional diagnostic over individually schema-valid proposals. Micro bag-of-fields diagnostic; it can miss cross-proposal field association errors. Strict proposal and full-case metrics preserve associations.
definitions.proposal_precision: Every attempted invalid proposal is a false positive; missing or invalid full envelopes still fail end-to-end. Valid proposals can be evaluated separately from envelope errors.
definitions.consistency: Translations of a family must all yield the same valid semantic output; consistency alone does not establish correctness.
definitions.telemetry: Only supplied measured values are summarised. Missing cost/latency is unknown, not zero. Attempts includes the first request.
definitions.scope: Scores against unreviewed synthetic draft labels are development diagnostics, not research findings. No provider is called by this tool.

uncertainty.method: percentile bootstrap resampling entire intent families with replacement
uncertainty.limitations: Synthetic draft families are not a representative institutional sample. Degenerate intervals at 0/1 do not establish certainty. Undefined classes stay null; fewer than two families have no interval.
